title: Genetically higher BMD is associated with higher knee-osteoarthritis risk yet lower fracture risk: pleiotropy-aware Mendelian-randomisation evidence
description: Analysis code, configuration, and reproduction material for the manuscript "Genetically higher BMD is associated with higher knee-osteoarthritis risk yet lower fracture risk: pleiotropy-aware Mendelian-randomisation evidence" (submitted to Osteoarthritis and Cartilage). The repository contains the full Python/R pipeline (LDSC genetic correlation across 78 phenotype pairs, two-sample Mendelian randomisation with MR-Egger / weighted median / MR-PRESSO / leave-one-out, multivariable MR conditioning on adult height and BMI, colocalisation, MRlap sample-overlap correction, and statistical power) and the derived outputs needed to reproduce every table and figure, including the multivariable-MR height/BMI grid and the colocalisation contrast. v2.8 (this archive) supersedes v2.7 and adds a second, statistics-focused remediation pass plus a new numerical-consistency gate; it inherits all v2.7 content (descriptive multi-phenotype genetic-architecture plus triangulation reframing with the Systemic Osteogenic Set-point downgraded to a post-hoc interpretive hypothesis, five Reviewer-2 mandatory items, and the eighth-round P0 N1/N2 fixes with nine P1/P2 items). The v2.8 delta resolves five MAJOR statistical defects: (N3) PP.H4>=0.8 is restated as a Bayesian posterior decision rule, not frequentist multiplicity control, and the paired-Wilcoxon p is labelled unadjusted/exploratory; (N4) weighted-median estimates are disclosed as matching the IVW sign while shrinking to about 0.35-0.43 of its magnitude at arms/legs (legs bootstrap CI -0.003 to +0.132 crosses zero), so sign concordance is no longer offered as robustness evidence; (N5) MR-PRESSO outlier removal is explicitly not removal of systematic/balanced horizontal pleiotropy (9/10 distortion tests significant), and Figures S11/S20 are demoted from robustness grids to comparison grids; (N6) MDE = 2.8 x SE is restored to a design-sensitivity quantity, the exclusion limits are the 95% CI upper bounds 0.0897/0.0937/0.1047, and the observed-power fallacy, random-effects SE, forward/reverse beta incommensurability and Steiger-versus-effect-size-MDE confusion are corrected; (N7) the cross-trait LDSC intercept lambda is an intercept, not a sample-overlap fraction, eight of ten values are negative, and Pearson r = -0.23 shows the away-from-null shift is driven by weak-instrument/winner's-curse correction rather than the lambda sign. Two new verification scripts accompany this archive: code/448 (141 cross-carrier assertions) and code/450 (an eighth gate of 65 cross-table numerical-consistency assertions derived only from authoritative CSVs and supplementary tables, including five negative self-tests). Nine verification checks remain green (148 COMPLIANT: abstract 346/350, body 3992/4000, 50 refs, 8 display items; 149b SAFE; 182 79/79; 310 99/99 NO REGRESSION; 331 31/31; 334 18/18; 336 docx Word-like 3997/4000 COMPLIANT; code/448 141/141; code/450 65/65). No reported beta/SE/p/OR/CI changed relative to v2.7; no statistical analysis was re-run. Raw GWAS summary statistics are not redistributed; they are publicly published (cited in the manuscript) and re-derived by the pipeline.

notes: Submission v2.8 (2026-11-16). This is a substantive statistics-focused remediation archive, NOT a metadata-only re-archive: .zenodo.json version was bumped to v2.8 BEFORE tagging, so the minted record carries the correct version label (the earlier v2.6 -> v2.6.1 correction is not repeated). Two local commits since tag v2.7 (d745824, 4537d4c), plus this release-preparation commit, implement the N3-N7 second-pass remediation of five MAJOR statistical defects and add the eighth gate. All changes are confined to definitions, table captions/notes and interpretive self-consistency: no reported beta/SE/p/OR/CI changed and no statistical analysis was re-run. N3: PP.H4>=0.8 is a posterior rule, Wilcoxon p unadjusted/exploratory. N4: weighted-median magnitude shrinkage and legs CI crossing zero propagated to Abstract/Results/Strengths; sign-only agreement no longer robustness evidence. N5: MR-PRESSO outlier removal is not robustness against systematic pleiotropy; S11/S20 demoted to comparison grids. N6: MDE restored to design sensitivity; exclusion limits are 95% CI upper bounds 0.0897/0.0937/0.1047; observed-power fallacy, random-effects SE, beta-unit incommensurability and Steiger clarified. N7: lambda is an intercept, 8/10 negative; Pearson r -0.23 attributes the away-from-null shift to winner's-curse correction. New code/448 (141 cross-carrier checks) and code/450 (65 cross-table numerical-consistency checks with five negative self-tests).
